bigquery.reservations.create: To create the Rubrik-managed reservation that backup and recovery jobs run on.
bigquery.reservations.delete: To delete the Rubrik-managed reservation once no job needs it.
bigquery.reservations.get: To get state of the Rubrik-managed reservation.
bigquery.reservations.list: To list reservations in the project.
bigquery.reservations.update: To update slot capacity of the Rubrik-managed reservation.
bigquery.reservations.use: To use the Rubrik-managed reservation for running backup and recovery jobs.
cloudquotas.quotas.get: To get the slot quota of the project, so a reservation stays within it.
